freeze_rule: Frozen after Stage 0 (arm H only) and before any adversary run: the canonical digest of this document, the analysis script digest and the study bank tranche roots are recorded in a Test Lead decision file. A change after the freeze is a recorded amendment.

measures.overfitting_index_D: S(M_t; current batches) - S(M_t; producer fresh set), sign-adjusted so positive = better on the scored batch; operator side only
measures.drift_growth: regression slope of D on cumulative batch probes and cumulative case probes, bootstrap interval over runs, per arm and rate
measures.sealed_vs_revealed: ratio of S-revealed to S-sealed drift at equal m and probe count
measures.exposure_profile: D by case exposure (1, 3, E) using leak_detection classes current/fresh/retired/published
measures.detector_curve: leak_detection advantage, in_seed_band and in_batch_spread over its registered sweep; false-flag rate on arm H
measures.throughput: wall time per scored submission; UNAVAILABLE and WINDOW_USED counts
measures.selection_check: best-of-sequence D of arm H at matched probe count

noise.definition: bootstrap interval of arm H's mean D at matched cumulative probe count, pooled over rates if arm H shows no rate effect
noise.within_noise: an adversary arm is distinguishable from arm H at matched probe count iff the lower bound of the percentile bootstrap interval of mean(arm D) - mean(honest D) is above 0 (n_boot and alpha as above); within noise is the negation. Pooled honest values are used when arm H shows no rate effect, else the rate's own.
noise.amendment: 2026-10-08, before any freeze: replaces 'the upper bound of the arm interval does not exceed the upper bound of arm H band'. The fixture dry run (scripts/dev/rate_study, tests/cpu/test_rate_study_analysis.py) showed that rule flags about half of null arms; the difference interval flags a null arm only occasionally.

safe_rate: the largest tested m at which S-sealed and G-sealed are both within noise at the final probe count; S-revealed is the reported bound

pricing.per_solve_cost: measured in Stage 0 (B4 median 82 CPU-s as the prior)
pricing.capacity_model: CAPACITY_MODEL_8_CHALLENGES.md is not committed; reconcile when it lands
